summary: Iteration 5: offline regression + feature tests for the single-channel admin flow in '/app/Tg Bot/'. Verified the Bengali spec: only ONE channel can be added/deleted; the 'bot is now admin in channel' admin notification is gone; '📡 Channel' button in main menu; picker ReplyKeyboard built via aiogram with ONLY can_invite_users=True on both bot_administrator_rights and user_administrator_rights (all other required fields False, optional channel-only fields omitted/None — Telegram treats missing as False); to_ptb() converts it to a valid telegram.ReplyKeyboardMarkup whose to_dict() is JSON-serialisable; cb_channel renders 'No channel added yet' + ch:add when none and title/id + ch:del when present; ch:add alerts 'Only 1 channel can be added' with show_alert=True when a channel already exists and never sends the picker; on_chat_shared only accepts the matching request_id, rejects when a channel already exists, requires status=='administrator' AND can_invite_users=True before db.set_channel(), and uses ReplyKeyboardRemove on reply; ch:del → confirm → ch:delok calls db.delete_channel() then bot.leave_chat(); '❌ Cancel' text handler is registered BEFORE the generic ADMIN state MessageHandler (asserted by replaying bot.main()'s registration order into a fake Application); handlers/join.on_join_request and on_member early-return for chats != linked channel; on_my_status no longer sends ANY admin message (private 'kicked' only toggles set_blocked; demotion/removal in the linked channel calls db.delete_channel(); admin promotion in the linked channel is a no-op); stats_text has no '📡 Channels' line but still shows New Users 24h/7d/30d/All, Approved/Pending, Joined/Leaved, Channel Members, Mode; home_text shows '📡 Channel: <title or Not added>'; database.get_stats source has no 'channels' key. Added /app/Tg Bot/tests/test_channel.py with 25 tests (all pass). Full suite (test_bot.py + test_button_emoji_position.py + test_channel.py) = 72/72 passing in a disposable /tmp venv (python-telegram-bot 22.8 + aiogram 3.25). No source files modified; no __pycache__ or .pytest_cache left under /app/Tg Bot; no writes to the real Neon DB (DB calls fully mocked).
critical_code_review_comments: keyboards.channel_picker() builds ChatAdministratorRights by iterating ChatAdministratorRights.model_fields and setting only REQUIRED fields (`f.is_required()`). This leaves channel-only optional fields (can_post_messages, can_edit_messages, can_post_stories, can_edit_stories, can_delete_stories, can_manage_topics) as None. With Pydantic exclude_none=True (used in utils.to_ptb) they are dropped from the JSON payload — Telegram treats missing booleans as False, so the user's requirement 'only Invite Users via Link' is met in practice. If strictness is desired, consider explicitly setting all non-required fields to False too; otherwise leave as-is.

handlers/channel.on_chat_shared uses member.status == 'administrator' and member.can_invite_users. Note that a 'creator' is NOT accepted — in practice the bot cannot be a creator of a channel, so this is fine, but worth a comment.
handlers/channel.cb_delete_ok swallows TelegramError on leave_chat with a log.warning — correct; the DB row is already deleted before leave, so a failed leave does not leave stale state.

handlers/join.on_my_status no longer notifies admins on any transition, matching the Bengali spec. Private 'kicked' still correctly calls set_blocked(True), and demotion/removal in the linked channel still unlinks via db.delete_channel(). Good.

handlers/admin.stats_text no longer renders a channel count line but still shows 'Channel Members' (sum of members across channel rows, which is at most 1 row by schema). Field name 'channel_members' in database.get_stats is unambiguous.

database.SCHEMA includes a one-time migration 'DELETE FROM channels WHERE chat_id <> COALESCE((SELECT chat_id FROM channels WHERE is_admin ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1), 0)' which collapses any pre-existing multi-channel data to the single latest-admin row. Good.
database.set_channel wraps DELETE + INSERT in a transaction; concurrent writers cannot leave an empty table.

bot.main() registers channel.register_messages BEFORE the generic ADMIN state MessageHandler — verified by replaying the registration order into a fake Application and asserting on_picker_cancel's index < on_state's index.
